eng. Ahmed 
Abd el Halim, tested by eng. Mohamed Salah 
El-din Badawy , accepted by eng. Hassan El Refaie: general director, revised by EDEPC 
inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar & 
eng. Saad Basuony, approved by eng. Mohamed El Sarag: 
head sector of Damietta PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control's general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles. ...etc
The charger must be out of service and isolated.
